units.source_text: 柏木那非常认真的、冒渎式的诵经法也感染了我，我以那里的学生用鼻哼歌似的心境诵读了。

en.t: Kashiwagi's intensely earnest, almost blasphemous way of chanting also infected me, and I recited with the feeling of one of the students there humming a tune through his nose.

units.source_text: 这小小的渎圣行为却大大地解放了我的感觉，使我充满了勃勃的生气。

en.t: Yet this small act of sacrilege greatly liberated my senses and filled me with vigorous life.
